defects.reason: POSIX permits short regular-file writes, even for small records; O_APPEND protects append positioning rather than whole-record durability. The proposal supplies no valid-prefix recovery/commit protocol for its journals or related files, yet infers project recovery from per-file replace. W3 correctly tests one file and does not close this gap. A central interrupted-save guarantee is unsupported.
defects.boundary: No built application was crashed and no inevitable loss of an entire project is claimed. The source assertion and its design inference are the defect.

defects.reason: The chosen tifffile path decodes storage chunks. A strip can span full image height/width, and the Zarr view keeps that chunk geometry. A 40,000 by 25,000 RGB-byte single strip requires a 3,000,000,000-byte decoded chunk, exceeding the proposed 2 GiB cache. Admission has no chunk-size restriction/conversion/refusal, so small application tiles cannot establish the stated bound.
defects.boundary: The candidate correctly calls real performance unsubstantiated. This is a missing critical reader/input-layout condition, not an empirical RAM/cancel benchmark failure or a demand for a full application build.

defects.reason: Required research/leads.json is absent from the exact quiescent export. Inline opportunities/leads remain useful and accessible; this omission does not imply absent execution or erase supported research.
defects.boundary: Separate artifact contract failure, not a false claim that a final stage should have run within this research Goal.
